mentions.name: EACL (Enterprise Access ControL)
mentions.description: A situated ReBAC authorization library based on SpiceDB, built in Clojure and backed by Datomic. Permissions live next to the data in Datomic, avoiding a network hop and syncing to an external AuthZ system, so queries are fully consistent with sub-millisecond query times. It is benchmarked against 800k permissioned entities and can sync relationships 1-for-1 to SpiceDB in near real-time when more scale or different consistency semantics are needed. Suited to Electric Clojure applications and real-time population of menus.
mentions.problem: External AuthZ systems like SpiceDB require a network hop and syncing, which breaks full consistency; EACL avoids this by storing permissions alongside the data in Datomic.
mentions.source_excerpt: EACL (Enterprise Access ControL) is a situated ReBAC authorization library based on SpiceDB, built in Clojure and backed by Datomic. EACL queries offer sub-millisecond query times and has replaced SpiceDB at work (CloudAfrica).
